criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First paragraph is ~183 chars, so it survives the ~210-char fold whole. Lands the correction by juxtaposition rather than snark, a statute titled “Public and charitable use” set against AIDEA's own deputy director saying there is no tenant. Short of 10 because the trigger is gestured at before being pinned to outlet and date in line 3.

criteria.name: Mechanism load-bearing + AK consequence
criteria.notes: Mechanism genuinely drives a capital and sovereignty decision, with sector, named actors, decision and timeframe all specified. The thin side is the AI stake itself, which is anticipatory: the words “data center” do not appear in the notice and there is no tenant, power source or water plan. The post confronts this honestly rather than papering over it, which earns 8 rather than 7.

criteria.name: Layer fidelity
criteria.notes: Three bullets, three dossier layers, zero inventions. Every controlling actor matches layers[] exactly. Both dropped layers and the confabulated Anchorage ordinance are absent. Held off 10 because bullet 1 surfaces its controlling actor obliquely inside a subordinate clause.

criteria.name: Chokepoint clarity
criteria.notes: Names one layer, one officer, and both binaries that officer owns. The actionable-date-versus-chokepoint distinction is stated outright and justified structurally. Asymmetry is earned, not asserted.

criteria.name: Structural read
criteria.notes: Takes a real position grounded in the machinery rather than in suspicion. Concedes the legitimate case first, then relocates the argument to the seam the dossier identifies. Proportionate, not a hit piece, not neutral description.

criteria.name: Forward implication
criteria.notes: Concrete trigger (5 pm Wednesday 19 August), a clear statement of what lapses after it, an explicit positioned-versus-not test, a named reader set, and a specific ask to carry into the comment. Loses a point for omitting the filing destination (DNR DMLW LCS).

criteria.name: Primary-source quality
criteria.notes: All three layers trace to primary material and the chokepoint citation is the statutory text of AS 38.05.810(g). Two limits consistent with the dossier's MEDIUM confidence: the 810 linkage is inferred from attachment filenames plus the notice's term of art, and the signing officer is not identified on the notice.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Strong structural cadence matching post_001's short declarative punches, Alaska-first, business-literate, no influencer tics. One drift moment: runs more prosecutorial than post_001's opportunity-first posture, and the concession arrives late.

Bullets remain multi-clause and quote-laden, retained deliberately to preserve verbatim statutory language and layer fidelity.

criteria.notes: Closes on a genuinely debatable question wired directly to the chokepoint's two binaries and the single signature that owns both. No CTA, no rhetorical softener, no gotcha aimed at a named person.
